overnight.note: Preview before 15:00 — calls are only logged by the 15:00 scan.

S9.name: Volume Breakout (S9)
S9.rule: Close above a 6-month/1-year/2-year high (set 20+ sessions earlier) on ≥2× 50-day volume, with the 2 weeks before averaging ≥1.5× normal; then confirm 10 sessions later: price still above the level and post-breakout volume ≥1.3× normal.

A2.name: Dip in uptrend (21-day hold)
A2.rule: 5-day fall >12% while the stock is above its 200-day average.

A5.name: Dip in uptrend, +5% target / −10% stop
A5.rule: 5-day fall >12% while the stock is above its 200-day average; exit at +5%, −10% or day 21.

B4.name: 52-week-high breakout on 2× volume
B4.rule: Close above the prior 52-week high on >2× volume while NIFTY is above its 50- and 200-day averages.

GF.name: Failed gap-up short
GF.rule: Opened ≥1% above yesterday's close, now ≥0.4% below today's open at 9:20, and first-5-minute volume ≥1.2× its 20-session norm. Max 3 a day (largest gaps).

OFL.name: First-minute crash bounce
OFL.rule: First 1-minute candle falls ≥3%: buy at 9:16. One trade a day (largest move).

OFS.name: First-minute spike fade
OFS.rule: First 1-minute candle jumps ≥3%: short at 9:16. One trade a day (largest move).

O1.name: Momentum carry
O1.rule: Up ≥5% at 15:00 on ≥3× its 20-day volume (projected for the full day).

O2.name: Panic-day rebound
O2.rule: Stock down ≥3% at 15:00 on a day NIFTY is down ≥1.5%, while the stock is still above its 200-day average.
